name: 区民健康村の宿泊・食事にキャンセル料を設定
summary: 現在の条例には、宿泊施設や食事のキャンセル料を定める規定がありません。改正案では、利用を取りやめる時期に応じたキャンセル料を定めます。新しい規定は、公布日以後に申し込み、2027年4月1日以後に利用する場合に適用されます。
changes: 宿泊施設は、利用予定日の3日以上前なら0円、2日前なら利用料金の30%、1日前の指定時間までなら50%、それ以後は100%とする
食事は、利用予定日の1日前の指定時間までなら0円、それ以後は利用料金の100%とする
申請を取り消さず利用予定日に施設を利用しなかった場合、当日に取り消したものとみなす
規則で定める場合は指定管理者が納付を免除できるようにし、10円未満の端数は切り捨てる
who: 区民健康村の宿泊施設や食事を申し込む人
why: 宿泊施設と食事の利用にキャンセル料の規定を設けるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Sets cancellation fees for lodging and meals at the Residents' Health Village
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Setagaya City Residents' Health Village Ordinance
en.summary: The current ordinance has no provisions setting cancellation fees for accommodation facilities or meals. The proposed amendment sets cancellation fees based on when a person cancels their planned use. The new provisions apply to applications made on or after the date the amendment is promulgated for use on or after April 1, 2027.
changes: Set the fee for accommodation facilities at ¥0 if canceled at least 3 days before the planned date of use, 30% of the usage fee if canceled 2 days before, 50% if canceled by a specified time on the day before, and 100% after that
Set the fee for meals at ¥0 if canceled by a specified time on the day before the planned date of use, and 100% of the usage fee after that
Treat a booking as canceled on the planned date of use if the applicant does not cancel but does not use the facility that day
Allow the designated manager to waive payment in cases specified by rules, and round down any amount under ¥10
who: People who book accommodation facilities or meals at the Residents' Health Village
en.why: The ward says this is to establish cancellation fee provisions for the use of accommodation facilities and meals.
